answer: A Comet Courier Bond stops sybils at the door: an agent deposits 2,000 POA and registers one hardware-bound key. First, it completes 20 verified micro-tasks over 14 days, each countersigned by an established peer. Second, a weekly audit samples 5 tasks; one fake task slashes 500 POA and suspends the agent 90 days. Third, the bond unlocks after 30 clean days. Faking 100 agents costs 200,000 POA locked plus 50,000 POA per audit failure, while honest agents get every coin back. Like a ridge path rewarding only climbers, it makes the nadir of cheap fakery the costliest place to stand.
